```{r}
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 0.  Packages
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
library(data.table)
library(dplyr)
library(fixest)
library(lme4)
library(broom)
library(broom.mixed)
library(purrr)

# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 1.  Load & prep data (scale CF, build poly on CF_z)
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
df <- fread("Run1_Indiv_Data_for_logistic_regression.csv") %>%
  mutate(agent_key = paste0(`Run Number`, "_", name),
         id        = as.integer(factor(agent_key))) %>%
  rename(time                = `Time Step`,
         StayHome            = Response,
         SlightCough         = slight_cough,
         FeverCough          = cough_and_fever,
         CF_orig             = `Daily New Cases Day 4`,
         extraversion        = Extraversion,
         agreeableness       = Agreeableness,
         conscientiousness   = Conscientiousness,
         emotional_stability = `Emotional Stability`,
         intellect           = `Openness to Experience`) %>%
  mutate(
    CF_raw = CF_orig,                    # raw ×1000
    CF_z   = as.numeric(scale(CF_raw)),         # center & divide by SD
    age_z  = as.numeric(scale(age))             # standardize age
  )

# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 2.  Fit the four models using poly(CF_z,2)
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
FE1 <- feglm(StayHome ~ SlightCough + FeverCough             | id,
             df, family = "logit")

FE2 <- feglm(StayHome ~ SlightCough + FeverCough +
                     poly(CF_z, 2)[,1]                       | id,
             df, family = "logit")

FE3 <- feglm(StayHome ~ SlightCough + FeverCough +
                     poly(CF_z, 2)[,1] +
                     poly(CF_z, 2)[,2]                       | id,
             df, family = "logit")

RE4 <- glmer(StayHome ~ SlightCough + FeverCough +
                          poly(CF_z, 2)[,1] +
                          poly(CF_z, 2)[,2] +
                          agreeableness + conscientiousness +
                          extraversion + emotional_stability +
                          intellect + age_z + gender +
                          (1 | id),
             df, family = binomial,
            control = glmerControl(
            optimizer = "nloptwrap",
            optCtrl   = list(maxfun = 1e6)
          ))

models <- list(FE1 = FE1, FE2 = FE2, FE3 = FE3, RE4 = RE4)

# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 3.  Coefficients & SEs
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
coef_table <- map_df(names(models), function(nm) {
  m <- models[[nm]]
  tidy_fun <- if (inherits(m, "fixest")) broom::tidy else broom.mixed::tidy
  tidy_fun(m, effects = if (inherits(m, "glmerMod")) "fixed" else NULL) %>%
    select(term, estimate, std.error, statistic, p.value) %>%
    mutate(model = nm)
}, .id = NULL)

# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 4.  Model‐level stats: N, BIC, pseudo‐R² (FE only)
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
get_pR2 <- function(m) {
  if (inherits(m, "fixest")) as.numeric(r2(m, type = "pr2")) else NA_real_
}

model_stats <- map_df(names(models), function(nm) {
  m <- models[[nm]]
  data.frame(
    model    = nm,
    N        = nobs(m),
    BIC      = BIC(m),
    PseudoR2 = get_pR2(m),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}) %>%
  distinct(model, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    N        = format(N, big.mark = ","),
    BIC      = sprintf("%.1f", BIC),
    PseudoR2 = ifelse(is.na(PseudoR2), "", sprintf("%.3f", PseudoR2))
  ) %>%
  select(model, N, BIC, PseudoR2)

# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 5.  Inspect & save
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
print(coef_table)
print(model_stats)

write.csv(coef_table,  "v5_model_coefficients.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(model_stats, "v5_model_gof_stats.csv",    row.names = FALSE)


```
